name: The Rainbow Room Gay Bar
source:
Uncle Frank has asked you to work at his gay bar for the night.

Serve drinks, listen to the woes and drama of the patrons, and offer questionable advice to tipsy people!

[From [url=https://icelucky.itch.io/rainbow-room]Itch.io[/url]]
